pages.text: The Fort is the Ogre King's seat: a fortified settlement of guards, tribute, trials, and royal authority.$(br2)Bring supplies for a sustained assault. The walls are only the beginning, and every defender inside considers the same ruler worth protecting.

pages.title: Finding the Fort
pages.text: Use the Fort Map recovered from a Plains Outpost or purchased from an Ogre Merchant. It points to a guaranteed royal stronghold.
Survive the defenders, then decide whether the crown is worth the final challenge.
